rows.title: Idle Stop & Go (ISG) - Failure to Restart Investigation
rows.howToFix: Stage 1: Visit Honda dealer for PCM software update (free under warranty) - TSB 23-008, 23-009, 23-010 references. Labor: 1-2 hours. Stage 2 (if software doesn't resolve): Replacement of starter motor or related relays. Starter replacement: $300-$500 + labor. Relay replacement: $50-$150 + labor. Free if within extended warranty (10 years unlimited miles per TSB). Out-of-warranty cost: $350-$800.

rows.title: Second Gear Synchronizer Grinding and Pop-Out
rows.howToFix: First attempt: Fluid change with GM Syncromesh fluid (~$50-100, DIY). Bleed and change clutch fluid (~$50-150). Adjust shifting technique - slower, deliberate shifts. If persists: Transmission rebuild or replacement (~$1,500-3,000). Some owners use Amsoil MTX transmission fluid for improved synchro life.

After Damage: Full engine rebuild required ($3,000-5,000). This is a MUST-DO preventive maintenance for any early AP1 before high-RPM driving or track use.

rows.title: Compliance Bushing Failure (Front Lower Control Arm)
rows.howToFix: DIY Option: Replace with aftermarket spherical compliance bushings (firmer, longer-lasting) $400-600 parts + DIY labor. OEM: Replace full control arm ($300-400 per side) + labor = $600-800 both sides. Upgrade: Spoon or Mugen bushing kits provide improved feel and durability. Track cars: Hardrace spherical bearings (stiffer, better for motorsports).

OEM Honda axles or Ballade Sports OEM S2000 axles recommended for quality. Use quality CV grease (Redline CV-2 Red Moly, OEM Honda) with proper clamps (not hose clamps).

rows.title: Rear Differential Noise and Limited Slip Failure
rows.howToFix: PREVENTIVE: Change differential fluid every 15,000 miles (Honda spec) with CORRECT Honda S2000 fluid only. Use only OEM Honda fluid or certified equivalent - NEVER VTM-4. Track cars should service diff every 10,000 miles. Avoid aggressive launches and hard shifts. Inspection/rebuild if noise develops: $1,500-2,500. Full replacement unit: $2,000-3,000+.

rows.title: Rear Window Clouding, Creasing, and Scratching
rows.howToFix: PREVENTION: Insert foam tube or rolled towel in rear window fold when lowering to prevent creasing. Use soft cloths only - never abrasive materials. Clean in cool, shaded area to prevent vinyl stretching. Clean regularly with proper vinyl cleaner. Creases: Usually fade naturally after car sits in sun with top up (cosmetic only). Clouding: Frequent gentle cleaning with proper vinyl cleaner restores clarity. Scratches: No permanent fix - prevention is key.

Stay below 9,000 RPM if running stock AP1 retainers.

rows.title: VTEC Oil Consumption and Burning
rows.howToFix: First: Check and replace PCV valve (~$50-150 parts, DIY friendly). If persists: Valve guide seal replacement requires engine opening (~$500-1,500). For severe cases: Full engine rebuild ($2,000-4,000). Use synthetic 0W-40 oil with high ZDDP (Pennzoil Ultra Platinum 0W-40, Redline, or Motul recommended). Check oil weekly. Change oil every 5,000 miles for track use.
